builds.name: Reference: Long-range finish
builds.goal: Reference for Jhin: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A deliberate ranged finisher who plans around four shots, delayed traps and allied damage enabling a long-range root. Fix shot number, reload and target missing HP. Attack speed follows Jhin-specific conversion, not ordinary DPS; compare fourth-shot damage with ability-led picks. Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
builds.summary: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Jhin: Fix shot number, reload and target missing HP. Attack speed follows Jhin-specific conversion, not ordinary DPS; compare fourth-shot damage with ability-led picks.

Start with the early core (Collector, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Jhin launches a magical cartridge at an enemy. It can hit up to four targets and gains damage each time it kills. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.

The route fails Jhin's stated kit question: Fix shot number, reload and target missing HP. Attack speed follows Jhin-specific conversion, not ordinary DPS; compare fourth-shot damage with ability-led picks.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Collector, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Lotus Magic Trap
builds.summary: Measure E hit rate under allied mark plus W.
builds.goal: Measure E hit rate under allied mark plus W.
builds.hypothesis: E has 1 AP plus 1.2 AD magic damage and detonates after two seconds. W can root a target damaged by an ally to hold the trap; Rylai tests post-explosion retention, Shadowflame supports low-health magic damage and AP also contributes to Q physical damage.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy triggers E and W root condition is met before it detonates.
Measure E hit rate under allied mark plus W; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Opponent escapes before two seconds or AP severely lowers conventional shooting damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: E scaling with AD does not turn its damage physical.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.goal: Measure movement after crit and fourth-shot access with the same firing timeline.
builds.hypothesis: P has a fixed firing rate, converts bonus attack-speed stat into AD, and gives crit movement scaling with that stat. Attack-speed crit items can test per-shot movement and fourth-shot access rather than firing faster; Q kills before later bounces can prepare missing-health fourth-shot damage.

Measure movement after crit and fourth-shot access with the same firing timeline; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

failureConditions: Reload downtime and inaccessible targets erase per-shot gains.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.

Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
